import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the supplied CSV file
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/weather.csv')

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.scatter(df['temp_c'], df['aqi'], s=df['precip_mm'] * 40)

ax.set_xlim(left=0)

plt.show()
